decisions.assessment: Small green onion food sense; distinct from chive/leek and from unrelated clearcut. Original noodle garnish sentence and plural agree.
Concrete pan/pot cover noun, not a drainage cover; bilingual stirring sequence agrees.
Ingredient preparation phrase: thin ginger slices, not the entire ginger plant.
Finely chopped garlic ingredient, not a garlic clove; original sauce example matches.
Selected edible plant-oil sense; not all plant-derived industrial oils.
Cooking instruction, not a literal gold colour/material claim; potato-cake example selects pan-frying.
Causative heating to boiling, not continuing to simmer. UK the/US a distinction stated.
Duplicate approved admin head: preserve the independently approved target body and admit only exact additional Chinese names.

Lower-fat milk noun; no unsupported fat percentage or dietary recommendation.
Revised zero-or-very-low sugar wording avoids absolute-zero and zero-calorie claims; no-added-sugar is not substituted.
Small cooking quantity only; figurative scepticism is not mixed into the food sense.
Revised alias limited to fish-like odour, not every blood/meat odour; no suspicious/figurative adjective sense.
Material suitable for its corresponding food use, not a guarantee of edibility or all-temperature safety.
Product-identification coding pattern; no conflation with a phone payment code.
Shelf product/price label, distinct from the product barcode; original checkout price comparison matches.
Cashier-assisted checkout, distinct from self-checkout and from a customer-service hotline.
Retail anti-theft device, not an identity label; payment/removal sequence agrees.
Tax already in displayed price; not a general promise about shipping or other charges.
Tax excluded from quoted amount; no percentage or legal pricing rule invented.
Geographic delivery coverage, not a delivery time slot.
Parcel pickup from home, not home delivery or an art collection; parcel-too-heavy context narrows it.
Physical package damage, not presumed loss; photo-before-opening temporal relationship preserved.
Postage-paid label; official USPS use independently checked, no assumption that every label is prepaid.
Viewing shipment progress/status, not tracking a person; depot arrival example agrees.
Listed price excludes delivery charge, not a claim the seller never ships.
Sew/turn the bottom edge; meaning says often adjusts length rather than all kinds of tailoring.
Finished bottom edge, not the whole trouser leg; loose stitching example fits.
Replace shoe soles, not generic repair or polishing.
General repair service, with resoling reference as one concrete example, not the sole repair type.
Shoe area containing toes, not a separate storage box.
Door/window sealing material noun. Separate canonical weather stripping form was removed to avoid shadowing it.
Reducing sound transmission, not merely absorbing room echoes; original partition example matches.
Full-body dressing mirror, not necessarily freestanding or floor-mounted.
Rent becoming higher; proposed future increase remains proposed in Chinese, not already charged.
Revised aliases identify the bill/document, not unqualified utility costs.
Agreed utilities are included, not an invented promise of all possible utilities/unlimited use.
Initial housing-condition check; no legal rule or prescribed deadline claimed.
Security money for tenancy obligations, distinct from prepaid rent; no refund entitlement invented.
Separate fee for cleaning, not a refundable security deposit.
Read a usage-measurement device; no implication the reading is necessarily reported or paid.
Sudden tyre failure/loss of air, distinct from a slow leak; UK/US spelling forms fit.
Air escaping from a tyre, not by itself a sudden blowout.
Insufficient starting power selected sense, not necessarily irreparable physical failure.
External-source starting after low battery, not engine repair instructions.
Child travel safety seat, not any back seat; no age/size legal advice.
Cede an occupied seat to another person, not cancel a booking; actual pronoun/past forms match.
Revised aliases name a bus specifically; no train or generic last-service equivalence.
Road-traffic build-up; original duration and delay meaning agree.
Selected hotel self-check-in rather than automatically an airline boarding procedure.
Breakfast cost included in room/package rate; no claim of a free room.
A platform used for a view, not a software platform.
Evacuation path, not necessarily a single doorway or a legal compliance guarantee.
Container for takeaway food, not takeaway itself; leaking-sauce example agrees.
Mesh cover to reduce splashes, not an airtight pot lid.

Wall base trim, not a floor board; British term selected accurately.
Selected road-junction noun only, not playground equipment or indirect adjective.
Moving windscreen rain-clearing device, not windscreen washer fluid.
